_comment: Canonical example of the `RunResult` shape that OpenMontage's adapter (`tools/external/claude_video.py`) consumes. Matches the field set requested in docs/openmontage-integration-inputs.md §1 and mirrored in docs/MCP_SERVER_PRD.md §2.6. Tests in both repos pin against this file rather than re-derive the schema from MCP tool calls. The mp4 used as the source is a 10s Big Buck Bunny clip (public domain) — small enough to commit the *result shape* without committing the media itself.

transcript_segments.text: Big Buck Bunny is short animated film by the Blender Foundation.
It is made using free and open source software.
It stars a large rabbit with a heart bigger than himself.
The film is released under the Creative Commons Attribution license.

_recompose_return_envelope_example._comment: When `recompose` is called with this video_id, it returns the same inputs above plus project metadata. Shown here for documentation; tests should not depend on `project_id`/`render_url` being deterministic across runs.
